Chapter 418: Chapter 22: Choosing a Star Domain (End of this volume, please subscribe)_2

One Star Lord after another spoke.

Lin Yuan had entered the Sixth Rank before the age of one hundred.

Many of these Star Lords largely praised the Chikun Star Lord for his brilliant methods of mentoring disciples.

But now, Lin Yuan had entered the Eighth Rank before the age of one hundred.

All the Star Lords changed their tune, considering the Chikun Star Lord to be lucky.

Several Star Lords even felt envious when they saw Lin Yuan, thinking that if they had received such a disciple, they could have done no worse than the Chikun Star Lord.

...

This was indeed the case.

The Chikun Star Lord knew his own family affairs.

His guidance for Lin Yuan was actually quite minimal.

Apart from providing material resources, the Chikun Star Lord’s mentoring did not exceed five times.

“Hahaha, what’s the matter? Luck is also a type of strength. Not convinced? Try finding such a disciple yourself.”

The Chikun Star Lord was in a good mood, not only did he not refute, but he took pride in this fact.

…

The celebration lasted several days.

Lin Yuan quickly resumed his cultivation.

“The Eighth Layer Part of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path focuses on the integration of rules.”

Lin Yuan thought quickly, a vast amount of spiritual light surged in his mind, contemplating the gains of that body segment and transformed them into a foundation at this moment, continuously propelling Lin Yuan to open up the Eighth Stage of Martial Arts.

“Rule integration must have a pillar rule, I will integrate Tai Yin Tai Yang Rule with Space Rules…”

The foundation of the martial Dao that Lin Yuan cultivated was based on Taiyin, Taiyang, and Taiji.

Therefore, in the Eighth Rank, the natural course was for Taiyin and Taiyang to integrate with the Space Rules.

This was set as the path from the Second Layer Chapter, Third Layer Chapter in the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Of course, other Martial Arts Evolutionaries don’t have to do it this way. They can choose their own paths without being confined to Taiyin and Taiyang.

…

He ended his cultivation for the day.

Lin Yuan began to go through the gifts that other Evolutionaries had given him at the celebration.

Since the Red Kun Lineage hosted the celebration, the participating Evolutionaries, to some extent, expressed their goodwill.

Especially for Thirteen Peak Master with infinite potential in the Eighth Rank, why not invest now rather than when Thirteen Peak Master is unmatched in the Eighth Rank and entering the Ninth Rank?

By then, it would depend on whether they would even be accepted.

Although investing now was adding icing to the cake, it was still better than not investing at all.

“All the gifts together amount to about one hundred and fifty thousand Cubic Universe Crystals…”

Lin Yuan was in a good mood, this was much more than the gifts he received when he first advanced to a Seventh-Level Citizen.

When Lin Yuan advanced to Seventh-Level Citizen, hiding his true identity, many Evolutionaries were reluctant to invest too much.

But now advancing to an Eighth Rank Evolver, being an evolver under a hundred years of age at the Eighth Rank, which Evolver would dare to underestimate this?

“With my current Universe Crystals, plus several shares of income from the Martial Path Evolutionary Path… it’s nearly two hundred thousand Cubic…”

Lin Yuan’s face revealed a smile.

Universe Crystals, being a universal currency among the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky, not only held monetary value but also practical value.

Two hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals exceeded the wealth of ordinary Eighth Rank Peak Evolvers.

Of course, the wealth of most Eighth Rank Evolvers was concentrated in weapons and treasures; the number of Universe Crystals they held was not the main aspect.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan looked up, gazing toward the outside of the great hall.

“Thirteen Peak Master.”

Lin Yuan stepped out of the grand hall and saw a gaunt man standing there.

“Who are you?”

Lin Yuan looked at the gaunt man, slightly startled inside.

This man bore a striking resemblance to Nalan, the Assistant Tower Master, who had recently destroyed the edge of the Heiyuan Secret Realm with a flick of his fingers.

Of course, Lin Yuan deduced through the video that the person was at least a Ninth Rank Evolver, probably even stronger.

After all, the Heiyuan Clan also had five or six Ninth Rank powerhouses stationed there, but in front of Assistant Tower Master Nalan, these five or six Ninth Rank powerhouses didn’t even dare to leave the secret realm, watching helplessly as Nalan crushed a vast area of the realm’s edge.

It was only when the Insect Race powerhouses came to support that Nalan stopped and left.

“This is what the Tower Master asked me to give to you.”

Nalan smiled slightly and handed a metal box to Lin Yuan.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan’s expression was solemn as he accepted the metal box.

“The Tower Master values you highly. It’s been a long time since I saw the Tower Master treating a junior like this.” Nalan smiled slightly, and his figure directly disappeared.

“Nalan, the deputy tower master…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts raced. Nalan, the deputy tower master, must be the one stationed at the evolution tower overseen by Xia Qin, the Supreme Being.

“The evolution tower overseen by Xia Qin, the Supreme Being, is countless light-years away from Chikun Star Domain. Even with continuous wormhole shuttling, it would take hundreds to thousands of years to reach, yet the deputy tower master arrived in just less than half a month…”

Lin Yuan felt a jolt of shock.

“It’s said that after fully comprehending the complete rule model of space, one can master wide-range relocation techniques, moving hundreds of thousands of light-years in just one step… But that is an ability only Ninth Rank Evolvers can control…”

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

…

At the edge of the Human Civilization Territory.

Several immense wills penetrated through.

“Who was it, exactly, who detected Shisan, the Peak Master of Red Kun Lineage’s talent, and did not report it to the Insect Race Alliance immediately?”

The strongest of those wills suppressed its fury.

If they had known earlier that Shisan could step into the Eighth Rank before the age of one hundred, they would have done everything possible to eliminate him before he advanced to the Sixth Rank.

As long as he was killed before reaching the Sixth Rank, even a Supreme Being couldn’t bring him back to life.

“Those who didn’t report on time are criminals of the Insect Race Alliance!” the strongest will accused the others.

“I’m not sure. Pan Yong was in charge of Chikun Star Domain at that time, but he disappeared some time ago, and we have been unable to find him,” said one of the wills immediately.

“Right, he just vanished suddenly, now there’s no way to know why he didn’t report back then.”

“Vanished? Just like that?” the strongest will clearly didn’t believe it.

As long as the person in question is missing, no evidence can be formed, and the Insect Race cannot punish the corresponding clan.

“I suspect those people were bribed by the human civilization early on, which is also a setback for us,” said the third will immediately.

“Bribed?” the strongest will remained expressionless.

“I will continue to report this matter. As for you clans, just wait,” the strongest will said, then dissipated.

…

On Chikun Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“Is this the Soul-Settling Pearl?”

“A treasure that can withstand a moment’s attack from a Supreme Being?”

Lin Yuan opened the metal box, and a colorless, transparent pearl slowly floated up.

It faintly radiated an extremely gentle power, making Lin Yuan’s spiritual will feel as though it was soaking in a hot spring.

“Much more precious than an Eighth Rank spiritual defense treasure… No, even the Origin Fine Gold given by the teacher can’t compare…”

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

Origin Fine Gold is indeed precious, possessing growth properties, but to grow it to the level of a Supreme Being, one would not know how many resources must be invested.

The Soul-Settling Pearl, however, must be a treasure at the level of a Supreme Being, otherwise, it couldn’t block a Supreme Being’s momentary attack.

To know, a Supreme Being, mastering the complete Rule of Time, would kill an Eighth Rank Evolver before they could even react, yet this Soul-Settling Pearl could forcefully buy a momentary lapse of time.

With that moment, Lin Yuan could choose to self-destruct.

As long as he didn’t receive memory contamination from a Supreme Being, so-called death, under the resurrection means of the Supreme Being, was merely like sleeping a while.

“I have Yang Spirit at Chikun Main Star, even if I encounter a Supreme Being, I can just let my true self detonate without needing a Supreme Being’s resurrection…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself inside.

Regardless, it’s always better to stay alive.

…

Successfully refined the Soul-Settling Pearl.

Lin Yuan began to consider the matters he needed to face next.

That was to choose a star domain on the periphery and then oversee it for five hundred years.

“Most Eighth Rank Evolvers oversee for far more than five hundred years, like Chikun Star Lord, who, having just advanced to the Eighth Rank, has been overseeing Chikun Star Domain from that time until now,” Lin Yuan thought internally.

People have emotions, and so do Evolvers.

“Let’s take a look, choose which star domain to manage.”

Lin Yuan opened the map of the Human Alliance Territory to closely examine it.

An Eighth Rank Evolver in charge of a peripheral area will have the authority to name it; originally, Chikun Star Domain was not called Chikun Star Domain.

After Chikun Star Lord took charge, it became Chikun Star Domain.

“This place is the one.”

Lin Yuan focused his attention on a certain location on the map.
